author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000828143  CYTOCHROME C OXIDASE POLYPEPTIDE 7A (PTHR10510)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Fly COX7A (FBgn0040529), COX7AL (FBgn0037579), COX7AL2 (FBgn0085201) (and orthologs)


* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous source.


This node is annotated with:
cytochrome-c oxidase activity(CONTRIBUTES_TO) IBD | PTN000053697(MOUSE\|MGI=MGI=1316714\|UniProtKB=P56392)

but COX7A is defined as a 'supernumerary subunit' of the complex, and not part of the catalytic core (see [PMID:17091399](http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/17091399/?report=Abstract&tool=FlyBase) and [PMID:2887077](http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/28870773/?report=Abstract&tool=FlyBase)
So this MF term should be removed, thanks.
title: PTN000828143  CYTOCHROME C OXIDASE POLYPEPTIDE 7A (PTHR10510)
